messages:
Caroline: Quick sync — we need to lock the minimum usable surface (MUS) for the Q2 inference panel before we finalize milestones. Eng says they can deliver embeddings + single-turn text gen with streaming, but routing/rollouts and multi-model won't make MVP. Need a clear shipping checklist by EOD tomorrow. What are everyone's must-haves vs nice-to-haves?
Mike: Re: constraints — embeddings + gen is doable. Biggest risk is latency at scale if we enable continuous batching + KV cache without quantization. My proposal: ship with per-tenant small-batch mode, no autoscaling for GA, and a fallback route to hosted model. Metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, error rate.
Sylvia: From UX — keep first pass to a single prompt flow, no tool-calling UI, no model selector. We can hide advanced things behind an "Advanced" fold in v1. That cuts a lot of surface.
Ajay: Agree with Sylvia. Removing multi-model plumbing saves ~3 weeks. Tech suggestion: gate features behind flags: `mvp_single_model`, `mvp_streaming`, `mvp_kv_cache` and enable them for internal canary only. Rollout plan idea: canary on 5% tenants -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks.
Caroline: Decision candidate: MVP = embeddings + single-model streaming gen + basic telemetry + fallback to hosted. No canary routing UI or A/B for GA. v1 next quarter adds model variants, routing, rollout UI. Any objections?
Mike: No objections. One ask: keep an enterprise pilot path on Dedicated for model pinning — not GA blocking but should be a named pilot milestone. Also add a perf regression job in CI: `perf/latency-smoke`.
Sylvia: OK. I'll trim the flow and update the Figma mock to reflect single-prompt, single-model. ETA: tomorrow afternoon. @Ajay please confirm flag names & UI schema so I can hide elements properly.
Ajay: Confirming flags and schema. Quick rollout config snippet for the rollout service:
```
feature_flags:
  mvp_single_model: true
  mvp_streaming: true
  mvp_kv_cache: false
```
I'll open a PR to gate the UI and add the CI perf job. Ping me if you want a 15-min sync.
deploy-bot: reminder — timeline freeze requested for 1843590000 (UTC). Please file any scope change with `/scope-request` and include customer impact.
Caroline: Thanks everyone — I'll turn this into a cutlist doc and send the follow-up with the exact checklist and milestone dates. :thumbsup:
